text.en: Oranges are full of citric acid - that's what makes them sour.
Salt crystals are a mild abrasive: they help scrub loosened rust away.
Citric acid slowly dissolves rust - that's how many store-bought rust removers work. Salt is a mild abrasive that helps scrub it off.
The angle a ball hits a wall at equals the angle it bounces off (minus a little for spin and squish).
A glass prism bends each colour of light by a different amount - that's how it splits white light into a rainbow.
